title: Genie Lamp in Cosmic Smoke
description: A single ornate genie lamp with a turquoise body, golden handle, spout and base decorated with crescent moons and stars. Purple and teal magical smoke with bubbles and planets emerges from the spout against a dark background.
prompt: A highly detailed digital painting of an ornate genie lamp centered on a dark background. The lamp has a shiny turquoise body with swirling purple and white cloud patterns, golden ornate handle, spout and base decorated with crescent moons and stars. Magical smoke in shades of purple and teal with floating bubbles, planets and sparkles emerges from the spout, creating a mystical and cosmic atmosphere.
